findings.claim: The required exhaustive modelByChannel source-search proof is absent from the supplied acceptance artifacts.
findings.observed: The supplied warm-wave-5625 learning states that git grep returned 112 lines and reconciles category totals as 2 + 3 + 45 + 62 = 112, but no supplied artifact preserves the complete verbatim git grep -n modelByChannel src/ output or one classification keyed to each returned file:line. The supplied parent checkpoint likewise contains only a completion summary, and the historical RED/GREEN artifact is test evidence rather than the required source-search ledger.
findings.rationale: This evidence-only follow-up was created specifically to make every remaining modelByChannel reference auditable and prove that no forbidden production runtime read remains. Counts and conclusions without the raw output and exhaustive per-match classification cannot establish that all 112 matches belong to intentionally retained compatibility, maintenance, metadata, caller, or test surfaces.
findings.required: Supply the complete verbatim git grep -n modelByChannel src/ output, classify every returned file:line using the required categories, reconcile every classification to the raw match count, record the upstream compatibility decision, and preserve the scoped src/auto-reply/reply/ search showing its match is test-only.
